_read_me: Robot 3 (hot hands), practice money. Same-day trading of cheap, wide-swinging stocks (Matthew's mission, 2026-10-07). Rule: EXP-0004's VWAP snap-back, which LOST money after fees in that test; this is a live experiment. Stocks = EXP-0004's pre-declared filter ($2-$25, typical day swing 5%+). Out of everything before the close, every day. Changed 2026-11-04 (Matthew: 'help the trading bots'): fewer, deeper, fee-aware trades because fees were eating it ($203 of fees on a $1,000 start by Nov 4): buy only 4%+ under the day average, one trip per stock, max 8 orders a day, and sell at the average only once the gain covers costs (1.5%). Still an experiment; EXP-0004 found no setting that made money.
